source.description: A yellowed skeleton archer in a torn hood holding a weathered recurve bow, standing watchfully. Ribcage shifts subtly, bow arm sways, pale-blue eye lights flicker in empty sockets. Seamless loop.
The hooded skeleton archer attacks — it nocks a crooked arrow, draws the weathered bow fully back, then releases the arrow toward the camera and lowers the bow back to rest.

_notes: v3 humanoid character, south direction only. Idle animation job stalled at 95%% and eventually failed server-side; retried once successfully. Base sprite approved pre-session; self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
